label: Paper book · sleeves A + B
note: Sleeve A: H13 futures signal executed in QQQ (intraday). Sleeve B: overnight QQQ + GLD. Kill switch 15R on A ($7,500), 10% equity stop on B. Bots scheduled on the Windows PC.

sleeves.name: H13 in QQQ
sleeves.rule: NQ minus ES return over the 09:00 ET futures bar; trade only when |rs| is above its rolling 60-session median; QQQ market order at 10:00 in the direction of rs with an attached stop at 0.5 x daily ATR14; flat at 15:58.
sleeves.risk: $500 a trade (1% of equity), whole shares, cap 400
sleeves.expect: +0.09 to +0.12R a trade, PF 1.3 to 1.4, about 2.3 trades a week (NQ selection N 209, 2024-05 to 2026-03; holdout +0.19R, PF 1.83 on 56)

sleeves.name: Overnight QQQ + GLD
sleeves.rule: Hold QQQ and GLD only while the US cash market is closed: buy at 15:59, sell at the next open. The return of both accrues overnight; the day session earns nothing.
sleeves.risk: 40% of equity in each, 10% equity stop on the sleeve
sleeves.expect: QQQ +5.0 bps a night (t 4.5, 6,694 nights since 1999), GLD +3.7 (t 3.4, since 2004); book Sharpe 1.07 since 2004, holdout 1.05; about +7.7% a year at 80% allocation
